_readme: Timezones for the timezone panel, /availability, the availability poll and /session-times. key = short id (don't change it once members have picked it), role = role name the bot gives (created when the panel is posted, after confirmation), zone = IANA timezone (daylight saving is handled automatically). Run /setup reload after editing.
_blocks: Start hours of the 2-hour blocks members pick in /availability, in their own time. 24 = midnight to 2 AM (the night after that day).
_poll: The availability poll's time blocks are in pollZone; each option also shows pollAlsoShow.
_estimate: Members with only a timezone (no /availability or poll answer) count as 'likely' during these local hours, at estimateWeight of a confirmed member.
_display: /session-times shows every slot in these timezones.
